The Demon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

It is the Corruption counterpart to The Crimson's Tendon Bow.

Its best modifier is Unreal.

Tips[edit]

  • The Demon Bow (or its Crimson counterpart) will almost always be craftable after one Eye of Cthulhu kill, because it drops at least 30 Crimtane or Demonite Ore, which can be turned into 10 respective bars.
